components.css: .ds-card{font-family:"Source Sans 3",sans-serif;display:flex;gap:17px;padding:21px;border:1px solid var(--border,#dcded3);border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper,#fffefa);color:#233d34;transition:background .2s ease-out}.ds-date{width:49px;flex-shrink:0;text-align:center}.ds-date span,.ds-category{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.075em;color:var(--cranberry,#9b3345);font-weight:600}.ds-date strong{display:block;font:400 33px/1.25 Lora,serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-card h3{font:400 20px/1.3 Lora,serif;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:7px 0 0}.ds-card a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-card a:hover{color:var(--cranberry,#9b3345);text-decoration:underline}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold,#ae7935);outline-offset:4px}.ds-card p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#606b60);margin:8px 0 0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card{transition:none}}

components.name: View navigation
components.description: Transparent view tabs with cranberry selection line.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:25px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#dcded3)}.ds-nav button{font-family:"Source Sans 3",sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:12px 3px 15px;color:var(--muted,#606b60);cursor:pointer}.ds-nav .ds-current{color:var(--green,#183e32);border-bottom-color:var(--cranberry,#9b3345)}.ds-nav button:hover{background:transparent}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold,#ae7935);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: A warm, understated guide whose holiday character comes from cream, evergreen, cranberry, locally bundled type, and small outline icons. It is a working calendar with readable records. Quiet paper surfaces support comparison and clearly labeled certainty.

rules.name: The Visible Certainty Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with explicit Verified or Unverified text.

rules.name: The Scan Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for dates, times, counts, and calendar day numbers.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Reserve shadows for floating controls and geographic markers.

dos: Do preserve cream, evergreen, and cranberry across views.
Do retain local Lora and Source Sans 3 typography.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't replace the established identity with synthetic photography.
Don't convey verification solely through color.
